name: reliability-review
title: Service reliability review
for_each: select id,name from services order by code

sections.title: Accountable owner and policy
sections.sql: select name,owner,policy,review_due from services where id=$1

sections.title: Objective evidence
sections.sql: select code,basis,remaining_pct,state from budget_status where service_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Follow-up actions
sections.sql: select title,owner,due,status,resolution from actions where service_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select decision,note,actor,created_at from decisions where service_id=$1 order by created_at

name: error-budget-policy
title: Error-budget policy for review
for_each: select id,name from services order by code

sections.title: Scope and rule
sections.sql: select name,owner,policy,review_due from services where id=$1
sections.note: Draft for owner approval. This document does not execute or approve a deployment.

sections.title: Objectives
sections.sql: select code,name,mode,target,window_days from objectives where service_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Record handling
sections.sql: select retention_purpose,retention_review from services where id=$1
